items.title: Google Is Spending $17 Billion on a Wyoming Data Center and Says It Will Pay for 100% of Its Power
items.summary: Google just answered the loudest objection to AI data centers, yet the market barely noticed and one key supplier tumbled. The fine print on who supplies the power, and what the pledge leaves out, may matter more than the headline.

items.title: 3 Defensive Utility Dividend Stocks for Income-Focused Investors
items.summary: Three regulated utilities go ex-dividend within days of each other, and only one of them funds its growth without leaning on new shares. Before you chase the next check, find out which payout has the thinnest cushion and which carries the hidden dilution risk.

items.title: American Electric Power Company (AEP) Could Be 5% Undervalued On Infrastructure Expansion Plans
items.summary: American Electric Power Company (AEP) recently reorganized part of its business and created a new AEP Infrastructure unit to focus on energy projects tied to rising electricity demand from large-load customers. Recent share price action has been mixed for American Electric Power Company, with the stock down 1.9% over the past day and 2.0% over the week, yet showing a 4.2% 30 day share price gain and a 9.5% year to date share price return as investors weigh the new AEP Infrastructure plans...

items.title: How to Maximize Your Retirement Portfolio with These Top-Ranked Dividend Stocks
items.summary: The traditional retirement planning approaches no longer cover all expenses in nest egg years. So what can retirees do? Thankfully, there are alternative investments that provide steady, higher-rate income streams to replace dwindling bond yields.

items.title: PPL Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: PPL (NYSE:PPL) is scheduled to report its earnings on Friday, November 6, 2026. The company has a market value of about $26.9 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $9.4 billion in revenue and $2.3 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.3 billion.

items.title: American Electric Power’s Dividend Has a Data Center Tailwind. How Safe Is It?
items.summary: AEP just unveiled a $100 billion spending plan built around data centers, and income investors are asking who gets paid first. One Texas deadline in December could decide whether shareholders or new share issuance absorb the pressure.
